Its source mistakenly names ⟨0,1,3⟩ in one sentence; the equations and final answer correctly use ⟨1,2,0⟩. q-165042: r=c r′ forces c=1/2 from the exponential components, then t²=0, giving (1,1/2). q-131485: x+7z=-3 and y-2z=2 give x=-7z-3, y=2z+2, with z free. q-37649: R₂←R₂+2R₁ and R₃←R₃-3R₁ yield the selected echelon matrix. q-73913: x=-9+2y-7z, with y,z free, gives the selected vector parametrization. q-131499: dividing the nonzero row by 2 gives x=-2+4y-3z, producing the selected parametrization. q-131519: the last row requires 0=-8, so no solution exists. q-73959: elimination gives rows (1,3,-5,6), (0,1,3,-4), (0,0,0,-9), so no solution exists. q-20590: z=1, y=-2, x=0, giving RREF [I|(0,-2,1)]. q-131590: z=1, y=1, x=-6, giving RREF [I|(-6,1,1)]. q-10644: subtracting twice x+y=2 from the third equation gives z=-10; the first then gives y=-5 and x=7, hence RREF [I|(7,-5,-10)]. q-10636: adding twice the first equation to the third gives z=0; adding three times the first to the second gives 5y+5z=0, hence y=x=0 and RREF [I|0]. Its final row-operation label incorrectly assigns R₂:=R₁-2R₂; the displayed transition requires R₁:=R₁-2R₂.
